question: Select the number-triad in which the three numbers share a different relationship from that shared by the three numbers in the rest of the number-triads.
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) (13, 39, 65)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcb07cc8a18c149baa0fd332beab02e95d16d597d857d4f7796e54f04e5db89c.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24210dc3d6107c19ae142cd5b9540dda3abdf078f4b72a56a1053685341aa260.png] 

**3) (23, 69, 105)**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb661fed384020343eff6239fb7c5ba0805aa94165d005bb3a16f44546bf500a.png] **

**From the logic the third number should be 115 instead of 105.**
